cases.comparison: Require exact DNAME, synthesized CNAME, terminal A, and AD for the signed chain, and for a forged CNAME the BIND answer: NXDOMAIN with AD, the DNAME, and the CNAME derived from it.
cases.oracle: Independent signed zones and BIND delv validate the correct DNAME chain. delv authenticates the DNAME, discards the unsigned forged CNAME, and follows the name derived from the DNAME to a signed NXDOMAIN before candidate queries.
cases.purpose: Preserve and authenticate DNAME, its synthesized CNAME, and a cross-zone terminal answer. Replace an unsigned forged CNAME with the CNAME derived from the validated DNAME and continue.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-dname-chain-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/srv.err" & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; /usr/bin/cp -f -- *.out dnssec-queries.json "$HOME/" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 dname) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 2 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> "$HOME/resolver.err" & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 www.old.x.test A > valid.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 bad.old.x.test A > bogus.out 2>&1 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; v,b=(open(x).read() for x in ("valid.out","bogus.out")); ad=lambda t: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",t)); ok="status: NOERROR" in v and ad(v) and bool(re.search(r"old\.x\.test\.\s+\d+\s+IN\s+DNAME\s+ok\.test\.",v)) and bool(re.search(r"www\.old\.x\.test\.\s+\d+\s+IN\s+CNAME\s+www\.ok\.test\.",v)) and "192.0.2.81" in v; print("dname-chain=correct" if ok else "dname-chain=incorrect"); forged="status: NXDOMAIN" in b and "status: SERVFAIL" not in b and ad(b) and bool(re.search(r"old\.x\.test\.\s+\d+\s+IN\s+DNAME\s+ok\.test\.",b)) and bool(re.search(r"bad\.old\.x\.test\.\s+\d+\s+IN\s+CNAME\s+bad\.ok\.test\.",b)) and "wrong.ok.test" not in b; print("forged-synthesis=correct" if forged else "forged-synthesis=incorrect")'
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
